diets.name: Standard / USDA Guidelines
diets.notes: Baseline used for most nutrition labels.

diets.name: Ketogenic (Keto)
diets.notes: Carbs typically kept under 20-50g/day to maintain ketosis.

diets.name: Low-Carb (non-keto)
diets.notes: Less restrictive than keto; emphasizes reducing carbs without requiring ketosis.

diets.name: Paleo
diets.notes: No strict macro targets; focus is on whole foods, no grains or processed food.

diets.name: Mediterranean
diets.notes: Emphasizes healthy fats from olive oil and fish over saturated fats.

diets.name: High-Protein / Bodybuilding
diets.notes: Protein typically targeted at 1g per pound of body weight or higher.

diets.name: Carnivore
diets.notes: All animal products, no plant foods.

diets.name: Vegan (whole-food)
diets.notes: Higher protein requires intentional choices like legumes, tofu, and seitan.

diets.name: If It Fits Your Macros (IIFYM)
diets.notes: No fixed split; personalized targets based on individual goals (cutting, bulking, maintenance).
